generatedBy: Captain, checking FIX04's provenance finding and getting a different number
theFinding: source-receipt.json files pin MASTER_QUEUE.json by whole-file SHA-256. Every such pin is stale, and cannot be otherwise: MASTER_QUEUE is a shared national ledger that nearly every lane commits to, so any whole-file pin of it is stale the moment another family lands.
foundBy: FIX04, which noticed its three families pinned a digest that did not match the MASTER_QUEUE committed in the same commit

twoMeasurementsThatDisagree.FIX04: 9 of 302 receipts carry a MASTER_QUEUE pin, and all 9 are stale
twoMeasurementsThatDisagree.Captain: 78 of 302 mention MASTER_QUEUE and 12 carry a digest that does not match the current file
twoMeasurementsThatDisagree.whyTheyDiffer: different detection. I matched any 64-hex digest inside a node that mentions MASTER_QUEUE, which catches receipts referencing it without pinning it and may miss a pin stored away from the mention. I have NOT reconciled the two and neither number is published as the count.
twoMeasurementsThatDisagree.whatBothAgreeOn: every receipt that pins MASTER_QUEUE by digest is stale. That is the finding, and it does not depend on which count is right.

whyItIsStructuralRatherThanNeglect: The pin's stated job is to detect any edit to a shared national record. It cannot do that job: the record is edited by design, continuously, by every lane that lands a family. A pin that must be wrong is not a weak guarantee, it is a false one -- and a reader who trusts it learns nothing about whether anything relevant changed.
whatWouldWork: pinning the FIELDS a receipt actually depends on, rather than the whole file. VF36 established that the entry pin -- the family's own row -- does reproduce correctly, and that the whole-file pin moved at a bookkeeping commit that touched no field the build prints. The per-entry pin is already the working mechanism; the whole-file one is the broken one.
notFixedHere: Changing what receipts pin touches every family that carries one, under five running lanes. Recorded for scheduling.
grantsNothing: This records a measurement of the receipts.
